rules.error_message: STEP 2 BARRIER: UBO structure verification failed or falls below the 25% FinCEN ownership disclosure threshold [FinCEN 31 CFR Chapter X].
STEP 2 BARRIER: Global Sanctions Screen matched an entity or broker on the active OFAC SDN List [OFAC 31 CFR Chapter V].
STEP 3 FLAG: Logistics deviation detected. Transit vessel engaged in dark activity gaps exceeding 12 hours.
STEP 3 FLAG: Financial variance detected. Unit contract pricing deviates >20% from global index averages, indicating potential CBP tariff fraud [19 U.S.C. § 1592].
STEP 4 BARRIER: Pre-Disbursement Match failed. Commercial Invoice, Bill of Lading, and CBP Form 7501 contain weight or classification variances.
